empty_state.select_description: Pick a conversation from the sidebar to view messages
empty_state.no_message_description: This conversation does not have any messages yet

custom_prompt.placeholder: Override the system prompt for this conversation
custom_prompt.dialog_description: Applies to this conversation only. When empty, it falls back to the assistant's default system prompt.
custom_prompt.dialog_placeholder: Override the system prompt for this conversation here

compress.dialog_description: Uses the context compression model from the default model and prompt settings to summarize earlier messages while keeping recent ones.
compress.additional_placeholder: Optional, e.g. keep character relationships, key parameters, and to-dos

translate.dialog_description: The translation is saved below the current reply and won't enter the next round of context.

create.managed_hint: Managed by the app, ready to use
create.folder_hint: AI will operate on this directory; requires your trust
create.folder_dialog_desc: Pick a real directory as the workspace root. After you grant trust, AI can read, write and run commands in it.
create.folder_path_placeholder: Type or pick a directory path…

trust.title: Trust this folder?
trust.description: Once granted, AI gains the following abilities (revocable in Settings at any time):
trust.point_rw: Read and modify all files inside this directory
trust.point_shell: Run shell commands in this directory (commands can reach beyond it)
trust.point_revoke: Dangerous commands and writes outside the workspace require your approval by default; permissions are adjustable anytime

empty.managed_intro: Files here are maintained by you and the AI together — let it read, write and run commands to turn ideas into results
empty.folder_intro: The AI can read, write and run commands in this directory. Start with a single sentence
empty.example_1: Look around this directory and give me a structural overview
empty.example_2: Create a TODO.md and break my upcoming tasks into a checklist
empty.example_3: Organize what I paste next into a note and save it as a file

menu.delete_confirm_desc: Only removes the workspace record and conversations; files on disk are untouched.

shell.title: No usable bash shell found
shell.desc: The AI can't run terminal commands on this machine, so built-in read-only grep / find / ls tools are mounted instead. Install Git for Windows and re-check to unlock full command execution.
shell.recheck_ok: Bash detected — conversations now get the full toolset
shell.recheck_fail: Still no usable bash found. Make sure Git for Windows is installed
